summary:
Deep technical analysis of the existing MTP_TESTING codebase. Covers:
1. Complete architecture mapping of what exists (VAE + PPO + CARLA environment + edge deployment via socket PIL)
2. File-by-file breakdown of every component
3. The exact pipeline: Semantic Segmentation Camera → VAE Encoder (Conv2D → latent z∈ℝ95) → concat with nav_obs → PPO Actor-Critic (MLP 500→300→100→2) → steer+throttle
4. Edge deployment architecture: CARLA sim sends frames over TCP socket → edge device runs VAE+Actor inference → sends actions back
5. TFLite conversion for edge (FP16 + INT8 quantization)
6. Critical gaps and what needs to be modified for the BTP project
7. Specific code locations where changes need to happen
